newsitem.title: USA: Ukraine gets $300 mln World Bank coal sector loan.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine gets $300 mln World Bank coal sector loan.

text.p: The World Bank said it approved a $300 million loan to help finance the Ukrainian government's coal sector reform programme.

The eight-year programme aims to raise productivity in the economically viable portion of the industry, reduce subsidies, and provide a safety net for mineworkers and adversely affected communities, the bank said in a statement.
The loan, to be disbursed in two equal tranches, has a 17-year maturity with a five-year grace period, and was made at the bank's standard interest rate for U.S. dollar loans.
The World Bank loaned the government of Ukraine $15.8 million for a coal pilot project in May, 1996.
